title: Finite-open constant generators under extensions and retracts
statement:
Let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $B$ a finite field. In the category of sheaves of $B_S$-modules on the ordinary small etale site, every constructible sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes] belongs to the smallest full subcategory closed under isomorphisms, finite direct sums, extensions and direct summands and containing all sheaves
$$\pi_*k_!B_W,$$
where $\pi:S'\to S$ is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], $S'$ is integral [def-pc-integral-scheme], and $k:W\hookrightarrow S'$ is a nonempty open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion]. Here $k_!$ is ordinary etale extension by zero [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero] and $\pi_*$ is ordinary etale direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Membership in this smallest subcategory means that each individual constructible sheaf is obtained by finitely many such operations; no closure under arbitrary subobjects or quotients is asserted.
